title: Armory: Troubleshooting
summary: Diagnose common Armory failures by shrinking the loop and testing one fix.

blocks.title: Common Failure
blocks.body: If gear underperforms, check energy, stance, module side effects, and whether the enemy or hazard is asking for a different answer.

blocks.title: Reset The Loop
blocks.body: If combat feels like a wall, stop upgrading randomly. Identify the damage source, repair neglected pieces, simplify the route, and tune the loadout for that one pressure.

blocks.title: One Fix At A Time
blocks.body: Change one variable, run a smaller test, and compare the result. Fixing three things at once can hide the part that actually mattered.

blocks.title: Recovery Anchor
blocks.body: Use this to test the smallest fix before changing the whole route.
